company.name: Aurabeat
company.shortDescription: Aurabeat develops a smart air quality sensor that detects changes in air quality to save energy and effectively clean the air in homes.
company.description:
Aurabeat develops a smart air quality sensor that detects changes in air quality to save energy and effectively clean the air in homes. Aurabeat helps to eliminate bacteria, viruses, pollutants, and molds with a coverage area of up to 538 square feet.

Aurabeat utilizes sound energy and acoustic air filtration to improve air filter performance while reducing air filtration energy consumption, giving customers sustainable, pollution and virus-free clean air.

productsAndServices.description: An air purifier that uses a combination of HEPA grade filter, ultraviolet light, plasma, and silver ion technology to eliminate airborne viruses, bacteria, and pollutants, including SARS-CoV-2, within indoor spaces up to 1655 sq ft.
productsAndServices.name: Aurabeat AG+ Sanitizing Air Purifier

productsAndServices.description: A replacement filter set for the Aurabeat AG+ Sanitizing Air Purifier, including a HEPA grade filter with pre-filter and a nanocrystalline filter to maintain air purification performance.
productsAndServices.name: AG+ Filter Replacement Pack for Aurabeat AG+ Sanitizing Air Purifier

productsAndServices.description: A large capacity air purifier designed for extensive indoor spaces, utilizing similar sanitizing technology to eliminate airborne contaminants including viruses and bacteria.
productsAndServices.name: Aurabeat 3800 Large Capacity Sanitizing Air Purifier

productsAndServices.description: Replacement filter pack for the Aurabeat 3800 Large Capacity Sanitizing Air Purifier, containing HEPA, carbon, and PCO filters to sustain air purification effectiveness.
productsAndServices.name: AG+ Filter Replacement Pack for Aurabeat 3800

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Pre Seed round raised $125,000, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $4,602,260 to $3,354,267, a 0.73x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 77 (+40 over 90 days) and market heat at 79 (-3).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set

insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
